content:
The meeting must be scheduled on Monday between 9:00 and 17:00 for one hour, with all participants (Anthony, Pamela, Zachary) available, and Pamela cannot meet after 14:30. This means the meeting must end by 14:30, so the latest start time is 13:30 (for a one-hour meeting ending at 14:30).

- Anthony is free from 10:00 to 12:00 and 13:00 to 16:00, but the meeting must end by 14:30.
- Pamela is free from 10:00 to 14:30 (excluding her busy time at 9:30-10:00 and 16:30-17:00, and she cannot meet after 14:30).
- Zachary is free from 11:30 to 12:00 (30 minutes, insufficient), 12:30 to 13:00 (30 minutes, insufficient), and 13:30 to 14:30 (exactly one hour).

The only one-hour slot where all three are free and Pamela's constraint is satisfied is 13:30 to 14:30:
- Anthony is free (13:00 to 16:00 free).
- Pamela is free and the meeting ends at 14:30, which respects her preference not to meet after 14:30.
- Zachary is free (13:30 to 14:30 free, with no meetings).

No other slots work due to conflicts:
- 10:00-11:00: Zachary busy (until 11:30).
- 11:00-12:00: Zachary busy (until 11:30, and only 30 minutes free after).
- 12:00-13:00: Anthony busy (12:00-13:00), Zachary partially busy (12:00-12:30).
- 13:00-14:00: Zachary busy until 13:30.
- After 14:30: Pamela unavailable.

Thus, the solution is Monday from 13:30 to 14:30.

```json
{"time_range": "{13:30:14:30}", "day": "Monday"}
```
